_comment: BEATMAPPED-MAINLINE-CITY-JOB-OPERATOR-CONTROL-01 — the governed catalogue of city estates an operator is allowed to enqueue. This file is the ENTIRE operator input surface: the enqueue control accepts one `key` from this list and nothing else — no filesystem path, no source id, no free-text city, no registry JSON. Adding a city is a reviewed commit here, never a runtime argument. See docs/UNATTENDED_CITY_WORKER.md, 'Governed city-estate catalogue'.

_selection_modes.ALL_ACTIVE: The source universe is DERIVED, at enqueue time, from the named canonical registry: every entry whose active_status is exactly ACTIVE, in the registry's own order. The catalogue deliberately does NOT copy those source ids — sources/<city>.json stays the single source of truth (docs/SOURCE_REGISTRY.md), so a registry correction is never silently contradicted by a stale duplicate list here.
_selection_modes.EXPLICIT_ESTATE_FILE: The source universe is the already-committed, already-reviewed estate file named by `estate_file`. Used only for a deliberately bounded estate that is NOT 'the whole city' and therefore cannot be derived from a registry status filter.

entries.label: Berlin — bounded 5-source proof estate
entries.note: The already-proven bounded estate from BEATMAPPED-UNATTENDED-CITY-WORKER-REAL-INTEGRATION-01 and the live DigitalOcean trial. Deliberately NOT the full Berlin estate — this is the smallest real governed job, and is the intended FIRST normal operator acquisition cycle.
